question: Ajatasatru sent his minister named Vassakara to the Buddha to get his advice on the matter related with attack on the _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vajjis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vajjis**

 
 
• The Licchavis were a clan amongst the Vajji Mahajanapada of ancient India.
 
• Vaishali, the capital and homeland of the Licchavis, was also the capital of the Vajji Mahajanapada.
 
• It was later occupied by Ajatashatru, who annexed the Vajji territory into his kingdom during the Magadha-Vajji war.
 
• The Mahājanapadas were sixteen kingdoms or oligarchic republics that existed in ancient India from the sixth to fourth centuries BCE.
 
• Vajji or Vrijji was a confederacy of neighboring clans including the Licchavis and one of the principal mahājanapadas of Ancient India.
 
• The area they ruled constituted the region of Mithila in northern Bihar and their capital was the city of Vaishali.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mallas**

 
 
• **Pawa** and **Kusinara** were the capitals of Malla Mahajanapada.
 
• The kingdom covered the present-day districts of **Siddarthnagar**, **Gorakhpur**, **Basti**, and** Deoria **of eastern** Uttar Pradesh**.
 
 

 
• **Shakyas**

 
 
• Buddha was born in the Shakya clan.
 
• He was born as the son of Suddhodana, who was elected chief of the Shakya clan.
 
• The capital of the Shakya clan was Kapilavastu which is in Nepal.
 
 
 
• ​Koliyas​
 
 
• Gautama Buddha’s mother ‘Mahamaya’ belonged to the Koliya tribe and she married Suddhodhana, who was a king of the Sakya clan.
 
• The Sakya and Koliya ruled on opposite banks of the Rohini river in the current Rupendehi District of Lumbini, Nepal
